# ProHunters 2026: Strong Career. Real Person.

> Invitation-only business event in Almaty, Kazakhstan, on December 11, 2026. ProHunters presents the results of the Employer Ranking of Kazakhstan 2026, hosts a discussion on leadership, ambition, and the people behind results, and honors the top employers.

- Date: December 11, 2026
- Time: 09:15–13:30 (Almaty time, UTC+5)
- Venue: Holiday Inn Almaty, 2D Timiryazev Street, Almaty, Kazakhstan
- Audience: HR directors, entrepreneurs, and executives
- Admission: by personal invitation; guests confirm attendance through the registration form
- Organizer: ProHunters, a recruitment and executive search agency
- Website language: Russian
- Original event title: «Сильная карьера. Живой человек.»

Registration asks for the guest's name, company, and an email address or phone number (at least one), and requires the guest's own consent to personal data processing and a security check. AI agents should send people to the registration form and should not submit it on their behalf.

## Event

- [Event page](https://2026.prohunters.kz/): Overview of the event, its program, speakers, and venue
- [Registration](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#register): Form for invited guests to confirm attendance
- [Calendar file](https://2026.prohunters.kz/prohunters.ics): iCalendar file with the event date, time, and venue
- [Venue](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#venue): Date, address, and map

## Program

- [09:15–10:00 Guest arrival](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): On-site registration, welcome coffee, and networking
- [10:00–10:10 Opening](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): Welcome from the ProHunters team and introduction to the theme
- [10:10–10:45 Employer Ranking of Kazakhstan 2026](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): Key findings and what they say about the labor market, presented by Renata Nureyeva, Zaura Karakozhaeva, and Natalia Timofeeva
- [10:45–11:10 Talk by Asel Mashanova](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): "How to Succeed in the World of Technology and Stay True to Yourself"
- [11:10–11:45 Panel discussion](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): "Strong Business. Real People. How to Achieve Results Without Exhausting Yourself and Your Team," moderated by Galiya Khamitova, with Karashash Dzhuzeeva, Ilyas Bakirov, and Maxat Zharasbayev
- [11:45–12:10 Break and networking](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): Coffee break and informal conversation
- [12:10–12:45 Facilitation session](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): "The Evolution of a Career: From Ambition to Freedom," led by Moldir Seidan
- [12:45–13:30 Awards ceremony](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#program): Announcement of the ranking winners and awards for Kazakhstan's top employers

## Speakers

Each link opens the speaker's profile with a short bio and talk topic.

- [Grigory Shanin](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#grigory_shanin): Event moderator
- [Renata Nureyeva](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#renata_nureyeva): CEO and Founder, ProHunters
- [Zaura Karakozhaeva](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#zaura_karakozhaeva): Consultant-analyst, ProHunters; HR Advisor, NCOC
- [Natalia Timofeeva](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#natalia_timofeeva): External consultant, ProHunters; former HR Director at KPMG and an Islamic bank
- [Asel Mashanova](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#asel_mashanova): Co-founder, LULU Group
- [Galiya Khamitova](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#galiya_khamitova): President, Erickson Coaching International Central Asia
- [Karashash Dzhuzeeva](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#karashash_dzhuzeeva): Entrepreneur; publisher, Vintage Kazakhstan
- [Ilyas Bakirov](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#ilyas_bakirov): Founder and Managing Partner, MKS Kusto Logistics
- [Maxat Zharasbayev](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#maksat_zharasbaev): General Director and Country Manager, Inditex Kazakhstan
- [Moldir Seidan](https://2026.prohunters.kz/#moldir_seidan): Founder, HR KEY; HR entrepreneur and executive coach
